title: Rex and the Road Made of Pebbles
synopsis: After the winter thaw, Rex discovers a worn strip at the Pine Park entrance. Aunt Jo explains why the small repair needs fresh crushed stone, and Jack starts a new question in his notebook.
continuity_state: Before: Season Eight ended in winter with the snowplow and park snowblower finished, Little Bridge cleared for walkers, and Rex and Molly reunited at Pancake Hill. The winter snow has since melted, leaving existing buildings and routes intact. After: Early spring has arrived after a gradual thaw. A small worn patch beside Pine Park gate will be repaired; the rest of the finished walking loop remains usable. Aunt Jo has planned to obtain angular crushed stone with fine material from a processing yard connected by the northern service lane. Jack adds a question mark beside his old gravel drawing. No stone has yet been delivered or path changed.
